heading: Why is the idea of “Placemaking” unique in the context of South East Asia?
excerpt: Is the idea of “placemaking” same everywhere on the planet? What makes South Asia so unique from the placemaking perspective?

heading: Rickshaw as a “Placemaking” Catalyst. From the perspective of Rickshaw Puller.
excerpt: Saturday Bangladesh takes the streets and talk to the very people who mobilize Bangladesh’s iconic informal Public transport and the most powerful placemaking catalyst that exists on the streets.

heading: Public Space for Displaced Populace
excerpt: Azbah Ansari from Placemakers Pakistani interviews Asif Zeshan, initiator of Placemaking Bangladesh as they talk about how place means more for people who are displaced.

heading: My School, My Dream
excerpt: Saturday Bangladesh partners up with Placemaking Bangladesh to discover how schools become a “place” to dream and how participatory design make the place ownership a placemaking event.
